root_causes.description: The shipping service exhibits a severe server-side latency anomaly (server-span p99 mean ~5700ms, peaking at ~9650ms vs a ~2ms baseline) while its error rate, CPU usage and pod restarts all remain normal. Its only downstream dependency (quote) stays healthy at ~1.98ms, isolating the abnormal delay to shipping itself, which then propagates upstream to frontend and checkout.

Checkout depends on shipping and calls it during the order flow; the shipping latency injection propagates upward causing elevated checkout end-to-end latency. Checkout itself shows no independent resource or error anomaly, so this is propagated latency rather than a checkout-origin fault.

evidence.observed_value: shipping p99 ~5700ms mean, peak 9650ms; propagated to upstream checkout
evidence.expected_baseline: checkout latency near baseline when shipping healthy (~2ms)

root_causes.description: Frontend calls shipping directly and via checkout; the injected shipping delay surfaces as increased frontend tail latency. Frontend error rate remains normal (~0.004), indicating it is a victim of upstream latency propagation rather than the source.

remediation_steps: Inspect flagd configuration and the shipping Deployment for an active latency fault-injection / delay flag and disable or roll back it.
Restart the shipping Deployment/pods to clear any injected in-process delay, then verify shipping server-span p99 returns to ~2ms.
Validate end-to-end checkout and frontend latency returns to baseline after shipping is restored.
